mobbin:2fb6db4b-a04d-4ffe-b7a5-6ebb219da.summary: User opens Analytics Home and faces a dense stack of KPI tabs, realtime card, recently accessed tiles, and suggested metric widgets with per-card controls and an empty Insights area.
steps: Home — Active users tabs + realtime + recently accessed + suggested cards
Home — chart tooltip (unsampled / data source) over same dense stack
Suggested widgets row + empty Insights & recommendations
steal: Recently accessed report tiles with relative time (steps 0–1) — recents shortcut into Reports without new widgets.
Empty Insights illustration when nothing to recommend (step 2) — withhold chrome until there is a finding.
avoid: Many equal-weight cards (KPI tabs, realtime, suggestions, each with own dropdowns/links) and no single primary answer (steps 0–2) — raises scan time; user cannot tell where to look first or what 'OK' means.
mobbin:2fb6db4b-a04d-4ffe-b7a5-6ebb219da.fit: Module clutter counter-example: do not build an Essentials dashboard like this—conflicts with 'show little, precisely'; KPIs and deep charts belong in Reports, not competing hero widgets on the home.
